OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG000.3 (22 Oct 45) CIS
(SCAPIN-172)
APO 500
22 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Colonel Nebuyaki Iijima, 1669 Nichomi, Mejiro Machi, Teshimaku Tokyo.
The Imperial Japanese Government will apprehend and deliver to the authorities of the Omori Prison Camp Colonel Nobuyuki Iijima, formerly director of military training, Rikkyo Gakuia, whose present address is believed to be 1669, Mejiro Machi, Teshimaku, Tokyo.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN
Colonel, A. G. D.
Asst. Adjutant General.
